# santati Provider

The Santati provider manages the audit-log control plane: trails that receive events and log streams that forward them to a destination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    santati = {
      source = "jamescarr/santati"
    }
  }
}

# The API key defaults to the SANTATI_API_KEY environment variable and the base
# URL to SANTATI_BASE_URL, then https://api.santati.io.
provider "santati" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) A team API key with the `manage` scope that is not restricted to specific trails. May also be set with the `SANTATI_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) The control plane's origin. May also be set with the `SANTATI_BASE_URL` environment variable. Defaults to `https://api.santati.io`. A trailing `/` is ignored.
